title: "Activate Task Manager and Icons-Only Task Manager" shortcut does nothing
line: The Task Manager's own keyboard shortcut now moves keyboard focus to its tasks, so arrows pick a task and Enter switches to it.
explanation: A widget's global shortcut only emits Plasmoid's activated signal, which libplasma turns into toggling the expanded state. The task manager has no popup and never reacted to activation, so the shortcut did nothing and the next keys went to the focused window. Now the task manager handles activation itself: it puts the panel into keyboard-input mode and focuses the active task (or the first one); pressing the shortcut again while a task has focus releases it.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: focus tasks when the widget's shortcut is pressed

The task manager has no popup, so its "Activate widget" shortcut only
toggled an unused expanded state. Give the panel keyboard focus on the
active or first task instead, and release it when pressed again.

BUG: 499774
